rules.rule: Flag every new regular expression (preg_match, preg_replace, preg_split, or a regex pattern passed to a validator). Ask for plain string functions instead, such as str_starts_with, str_ends_with, str_contains, strlen, substr, explode or ctype_*, or an existing validator. Regex is hard to review and easy to get subtly wrong. Accept one only when no string-function alternative exists and the PR explains why.
